'''Kaink''' was the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Priest/Legends|priestess]]. She served as the guardian of the [[Soul Tree]]s, and the village [[Legend keeper|legend-keeper]]. She lived several miles away from the village where the [[Warrick family/Legends|Warrick family]] lived, leading a life of solitude and oneness with nature. Kaink carried a magical staff with a crystal on top. Kaink used her staff to emit a beam of mystical force when necessary, or at other times, to hypnotize animals. She accompanied the Ewok warriors on their mission to save [[Mace Towani|Mace]] and [[Cindel Towani]]'s parents. As village legend keeper, Kaink was deferred to by the formal title "Mistress Kaink." She was one of the few Ewoks who still remembered the heroism of the Ewok hero Erpham Warrick and the instrumental role of his great [[Ewok battle wagon]]. She told the legend to his grandson, Wicket Wystri Warrick, who later rebuilt the famous machine.

It's unknown whether Kaink assisted [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket]] and the other Ewoks in helping the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] to defeat the Galactic Empire in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

Shortly after the Battle of Endor<ref name="Star Tours">[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']]</ref> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency began offering [[Endor Express|tours]] of the forest moon. Kaink boarded a [[StarSpeeder 3000]] at one point and was featured in a safety video.<ref name="Star Tours" /><ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Star Tours (toy line)|packtype=Multipack|pack=STAR TOURS Boarding Party|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/StarToursBoardingParty.asp}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Kaink was played by [[Margarita Fernández]] in the [[1984]] film ''[[Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure]]'' and was voiced by [[Pauline Rennie]] in the ''[[Ewoks (television series)|Ewoks]]'' animated series.

Kaink was featured in the "safety video" and boarding party in [[The Walt Disney Company|Disney]]'s ''[[Star Tours]]'' ride. The Ewok costume used was missing her signature leather dress, but it was later revealed to be Kaink. An action figure of Kaink, minus her dress and staff, was released in the [[Star Wars: Star Tours (toy line)|''Star Tours'' "Boarding Party"]] set of figures as a Disney Parks exclusive. Two Disney exclusive pins have also been released featuring Kaink.
